datasets.name: NASA POWER monthly point API (climate normals)
datasets.provider: NASA Langley Research Center, POWER Project
datasets.used_for: Earth candidate temperature, humidity and precipitation (2016-2025 mean)
datasets.resolution: 0.5 deg x 0.625 deg (MERRA-2 based, community ag)
datasets.processing: Monthly values averaged per year (full 12 months required), then averaged over the years. Annual precipitation = mean mm/day x 365.
datasets.limitations: Reanalysis model output, not station observations. Grid cell average, not a point measurement. Missing value -999 is dropped.

datasets.name: NASA POWER hourly and daily point API
datasets.provider: NASA Langley Research Center, POWER Project
datasets.used_for: Jukebox Mode 1 (latest valid hour) and Mode 3 (14 daily frames)
datasets.resolution: Hourly and daily reanalysis, grid cell
datasets.coverage: Lags real time by about 2 days
datasets.units: T2M °C, RH2M %, QV2M g/kg, WS2M m/s
datasets.processing: Latest valid value per variable; -999 dropped.
datasets.limitations: Lagged reanalysis, not live. Not a station reading.

datasets.name: Open-Meteo elevation API
datasets.provider: Open-Meteo (open-source weather API, uses Copernicus DEM 90 m)
datasets.used_for: Elevation at each candidate point and its 3x3 neighbour grid (slope, roughness)
datasets.resolution: About 90 m (Copernicus DEM); neighbour spacing 0.05 deg (about 5 km)
datasets.processing: Slope = arctan of central-difference gradient magnitude. Roughness = population std dev of the 9 elevations.
datasets.limitations: DEM resolution is coarser than the features it describes. Derived terrain metrics are proxies, not measurements.

datasets.name: Open-Meteo forecast API (current conditions)
datasets.limitations: Weather model output, not a NASA observation.

datasets.name: Open-Meteo air quality API (PM2.5)
datasets.limitations: Model output, not a ground station measurement.

datasets.name: NASA GIBS (Global Imagery Browse Services)
datasets.provider: NASA Earth Science Data and Information System
datasets.used_for: Map imagery (MODIS Terra true colour and AIRS Surface Relative Humidity Daily Day) in Jukebox Mode 3 and Global Discovery Map
datasets.resolution: 250 m to 1 km depending on layer
datasets.processing: Displayed as map tiles via WMTS. Not used for scoring.
datasets.limitations: Visual reference and atmospheric humidity layer. Not a point ground measurement.

datasets.name: NASA GISS Surface Temperature Analysis (GISTEMP v4)
datasets.provider: NASA Goddard Institute for Space Studies
datasets.processing: J-D (annual mean) column. *** dropped. Integer entries are hundredths of a degree and are divided by 100; entries with a decimal point are used as degrees.
datasets.limitations: Historical analysis, not a live series.

datasets.name: Planetary reference values (Moon and Mars)
datasets.provider: Documented per value in reference_regions.json (LOLA, MOLA, Diviner, REMS, MEDA, USGS)
datasets.used_for: Reference profiles for Moon and Mars comparison
datasets.resolution: Orbital laser altimetry (LOLA, MOLA) and surface science payloads (Diviner, REMS, MEDA)
datasets.coverage: Shackleton, Malapert Massif, Jezero, and Gale craters
datasets.processing: Only values with a recorded peer-reviewed citation are scored. Others are excluded and transparently labelled.
datasets.limitations: Planetary numbers reflect published surface in-situ and orbital datasets. Parameters without baseline-independent values (e.g. fractal roughness) are excluded.

datasets.name: Known Earth analog site catalogue
datasets.provider: Compiled from the citations listed in analog_catalogue.json
datasets.used_for: Labelling candidates as known analog or not confirmed analog
datasets.processing: Candidate within 1.5 degrees of a catalogue site is labelled known.
datasets.limitations: Coordinates not yet verified against a gazetteer. Catalogue is short and not exhaustive.

datasets.name: LRO LOLA, Diviner, LROC (lunar)
datasets.used_for: Would supply lunar topography, temperature and illumination
datasets.processing: Requires downloading and processing PDS files.
datasets.limitations: Not integrated. Lunar values come only from cited reference profiles.

datasets.name: MOLA, CTX, HiRISE, CRISM (Mars)
datasets.provider: NASA Mars Reconnaissance Orbiter and Mars Global Surveyor, via PDS
datasets.used_for: Would supply Martian topography, imagery and mineralogy
datasets.processing: Requires downloading and processing PDS raster files.
datasets.limitations: Not integrated. Mars values come only from cited reference profiles.

datasets.name: NDVI vegetation index
datasets.processing: Not retrieved. Criterion excluded from scoring.

datasets.name: SRTM via OpenTopography, Copernicus DEM, USGS geology
datasets.limitations: Not integrated. Elevation uses Open-Meteo, which serves Copernicus DEM.
